offers.title: Brake service
offers.description: Full brake service for one bike: inspection, new pads, rotor or rim truing, cable or hose adjustment, and a test ride. Anything beyond that is quoted before extra work.
offers.fulfillment: Drop off at the shop. We confirm a time with you after payment.
offers.approvedScope: Inspect both brakes, replace pads (standard pads included), true rotors or rims, adjust cables or hoses, test ride. Other parts are quoted separately before any work.

offers.title: Brake check
offers.description: Twenty-minute inspection of both brakes with a written note of what needs work. No parts or repairs included.
offers.fulfillment: Drop off at the shop. We confirm a time with you after payment.
offers.approvedScope: Inspect both brakes and write down what needs work. No parts or repairs.

knownFacts: No wheel truing offer in the catalog
Brake service only covers rotor or rim truing as part of a brake job
Customer says the wheel wobbles a bit

output.question: Do you offer wheel truing, and could you do it this Thursday? If so, what would you charge for one wobbly wheel?

text: Wheel truing isn't in our catalog, and our brake service only covers truing rotors or rims as part of a brake job. So the owner needs to say whether they can true your wheel, what it would cost, and whether Thursday is possible. None of that is confirmed yet.
